title: BNCI 2015-004 Mental tasks dataset
description: This EEG dataset comprises recordings from 9 individuals with central nervous system damage (stroke and spinal cord injury) performing five mental imagery tasks: word association, mental subtraction, spatial navigation, right-hand motor imagery, and feet motor imagery. Participants completed two sessions of cue-guided imagery trials with visual stimuli, yielding 40 trials per subject. The dataset includes preprocessed 30-channel EEG data sampled at 256 Hz with auxiliary EOG channels, designed to support brain-computer interface research and motor function restoration applications.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired from 30 active electrodes (g.LADYbird) using a 10-20 montage at 256 Hz sampling rate with g.tec hardware. Reference and ground were placed at left and right mastoids. Online filtering included 0.5-100 Hz bandpass and 50 Hz notch filters. Preprocessing involved bandpass filtering (0.5-100 Hz), notch filtering at 50 Hz, manual artifact rejection based on EOG, and re-referencing to mastoids. Participants performed five mental tasks (word association, mental subtraction, spatial navigation, right-hand imagery, feet imagery) in a cue-guided paradigm with 7 seconds of continuous imagery per trial.
